title: History stored unencrypted on disk
description: MEDIUM: prompter-history.json stores raw user prompts (rawInput) and generated content (structuredOutput) as plaintext JSON. Consider adding optional safeStorage-based encryption for history entries or at minimum a warning to users.
resolution: Deferred - history encryption is a future enhancement. Current risk is low as history is local to user's machine. Added issue as feature request for future release.
